cases.title: Installed build and editor asset identity
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1 simulator; local API 3173 and loopback QA proxy 3174.
Install simulator 0.1.1 (2); use only the dedicated local QA fixture.
steps: Read the installed simulator bundle version/platform and compare its public resources against the built app and dist.
assertions: Version 0.1.1 (2), iPhoneSimulator, all ten files byte-identical.
failureSignals: A stale installed build or differing editor assets.

cases.title: Login and account retention during native HTTP 503
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1 simulator; local API 3173 and loopback QA proxy 3174.
Install simulator 0.1.1 (2); use only the dedicated local QA fixture.
steps: Use storage-unavailable mode, sign in, terminate and launch the app, and open account settings.
assertions: Authenticated workspace, unavailable usage instead of zero, unavailable document list instead of empty-account claim; correct QA profile remains accessible.
failureSignals: Login is discarded, usage is reported as zero, or account settings cannot open.

cases.title: Pending Word draft survives restart during 503
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1 simulator; local API 3173 and loopback QA proxy 3174.
Install simulator 0.1.1 (2); use only the dedicated local QA fixture.
steps: Open the fixture online, switch proxy offline, replace the body with numeric marker 5031213, confirm input, switch to storage-unavailable, terminate/relaunch, and open the local draft row.
assertions: Pending draft row remains visible while the cloud list is unavailable; opening it shows 5031213.
failureSignals: No draft entry, missing text, or a required cloud read prevents opening.

cases.title: Recovery synchronization and session cleanup
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1 simulator; local API 3173 and loopback QA proxy 3174.
Install simulator 0.1.1 (2); use only the dedicated local QA fixture.
steps: Restore online mode, terminate/relaunch, reopen the document, independently read its API content, then log out and restore endpoint 3173.
assertions: Draft entry clears, quota and document list return, exact Word content matches the visible marker, and logout returns to login.
failureSignals: Pending data is lost, stale text overwrites the draft, or logout fails.

cases.title: Registration during native HTTP 503
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1 simulator; local API 3173 and loopback QA proxy 3174.
Install simulator 0.1.1 (2); use only the dedicated local QA fixture.
steps: Create a fresh isolated account through the native app while the proxy is storage-unavailable.
assertions: New session remains usable while cloud usage is unavailable.
failureSignals: Account creation loses the session or reports successful empty storage.

lastRun.authSource: Dedicated synthetic local QA fixture; no production data or credentials used.

results.mode: native simulator UI and local fault proxy
results.notes: Installed and built app resources match dist. Native version was also visible in the connection dialog.

results.mode: native simulator UI and local fault proxy
results.notes: Native Capacitor HTTP proxy failures, not WebView fetch interception. Login performed with the dedicated local account; process restart retained identity.

results.mode: native simulator UI and local fault proxy
results.notes: Native input was committed before termination. The initial Latin phrase entered through the active Pinyin input method was replaced with an unambiguous numeric marker; this case makes no IME fidelity claim.

results.mode: native simulator UI and local fault proxy
results.notes: Independent authenticated API readback deeply matches the recovered Word document. Initial pre-recovery readback lacked Origin and returned 403; no pre-recovery server-content assertion is claimed. Final successful readback used the required Origin and logged out its API session. Test account/document retained locally; native app logged out, endpoint restored, proxy/mirror stopped and only the task simulator shut down.

results.mode: native simulator UI and local fault proxy
results.notes: The account was prepared through the local API before login QA; native registration during 503 was not exercised.
